verdict.rationale: An operating system could plausibly ship official SDKs for building against it, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no official Ubuntu Desktop SDK. The closest items are general statements that Ubuntu ships libraries and toolchains and hosts IDEs and AI/ML software, plus a listing of AT-SPI accessibility DBus interfaces. These are platform-hosting claims or adjacent developer building blocks, not an official SDK for building against the product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
